Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely interpreted “the team … play for” as referring to Pa Amadou Gai’s club (ASC HLM) and concluded Senegal, instead of recognizing that “plays for” typically refers to a national team (The Gambia). This contextual misalignment and early closure without disambiguating club vs. national team set the workflow toward the wrong target and led to an incorrect final answer.
